findings.title: Letter-spacing on Arabic
findings.fix: Set letter-spacing: 0 on Arabic, for example :lang(ar) { letter-spacing: 0 }.

findings.title: Arabic set too small
findings.message: "يرجى تحديد تفاصيل العنوان لضمان وصول طلب…" is 12.8px.
findings.fix: Keep Arabic UI text at 14px or more, and body text at 16px.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: right: 14px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
findings.snippet:
<span class="input-icon">
                        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-line
